9-Day Istanbul, Petra & Wadi Rum Heritage Journey
summary:
The 9-Day Turkey & Jordan Trip connects Turkey’s historic cities with Jordan’s archaeological and desert landscapes. Begin in Istanbul before continuing to Cappadocia, then fly to Amman for the Jordan section. Visit Petra, spend a night in a desert camp at Wadi Rum, and finish at the Dead Sea. With Turkey focused on Istanbul and Cappadocia, the itinerary leaves Jordan to provide the stronger archaeological and desert component.
The escorted program includes selected 4-star hotels, one night in a desert camp, breakfast, guided sightseeing, entrance fees, airport transfers, two domestic flights and private transportation throughout Jordan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Wailking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise and Asia
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, one of the city’s most colorful and lively markets. Continue with a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia while enjoying views of palaces, mosques, and waterfront mansions. Cross the Bosphorus Bridge to Çamlıca Hill for panoramic views over the city, then visit the elegant Beylerbeyi Palace, the former summer residence of Ottoman sultans. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight from Istanbul to Amman
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Istanbul. Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight to Amman.
Upon arrival at Queen Alia International Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. Free time at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Amman, Jerash and Aljoun Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Amman. Enjoy a panoramic city tour, including visits to the Amman Citadel, Roman Theatre, and the Folklore Museum. Continue to Ajloun Castle before visiting the ancient Roman city of Jerash, including Hadrian’s Arch, the Hippodrome, the Forum, and the famous colonnaded streets. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Madaba, Mt Nebo and Kerak
itinerary.text: Continue to Mount Nebo, one of Jordan’s most important biblical sites, offering panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Holy Land. Drive along the scenic Wadi Mujib mountain route to visit the impressive Crusader fortress of Kerak Castle. After the visit, continue south to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Visit Petra and Wadi Rum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Petra. Explore the ancient city of Petra, including the narrow Siq, the iconic Al-Khazneh (Treasury), the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. An optional horse ride is available at the entrance of Petra. Continue to Wadi Rum, also known as the Valley of the Moon, and enjoy a 4x4 jeep safari through its spectacular desert landscape. Overnight at a desert camp in Wadi Rum.

itinerary.title: Visit Dead Sea and then return Amman
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the desert camp in Wadi Rum. Proceed to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth, and enjoy free time to relax and float in its mineral-rich waters. Continue to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Amman Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel in Amman
Check-out and transfer to Queen Alia International Airport for your return flight home

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 9-Day Classic Turkey and Jordan Tour?
faqs.a: The 9-Day Classic Turkey and Jordan Tour covers Istanbul in Turkey, along with Amman, Petra, and Wadi Rum in Jordan. This itinerary combines the cultural treasures of Istanbul with Jordan's most famous historical and natural attractions, creating an unforgettable journey through two remarkable countries. The tour runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-Day Classic Turkey and Jordan Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,875 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. International flights between countries and international arrival/departure flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Turkey and Jordan. Your guides will provide expert commentary on the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of the destinations visited.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines some of the most iconic attractions in both countries and provides an excellent introduction to the region's rich heritage and spectacular landscapes.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historical sites, archaeological areas, and desert landscapes. Petra requires several kilometers of walking, while Wadi Rum includes outdoor desert experiences suitable for most visitors.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and Bosphorus in Istanbul; the vibrant capital city of Amman; the magnificent UNESCO World Heritage Site of Petra, famous for the Treasury and rock-carved monuments; and the breathtaking desert landscapes of Wadi Rum, often referred to as the Valley of the Moon.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 9-Day Classic Turkey and Jordan Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 9-Day Classic Turkey and Jordan Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Cappadocia, Pamukkale, the Dead Sea, Jerash, or Aqaba, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
